label.purpose: Every caption, unit, column head and source; uppercase in English, not in Khmer.

shadows.name: pin-lift

shadows.name: flood-glow

shadows.name: flood-edge

shadows.name: panel-blur

motion.name: flood-pulse
motion.purpose: Only the rider-in-water state loops; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a screen: Start ride, Submit report. Hazard Red with a square arrow cell.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary: Report flood, Ride again.

components.name: Light Button
components.description: Confirming secondary on dark cards, such as Done on the arrival card.
components.css: .ds-btn-light { height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: #F4F4F5; color: #09090B; font: 600 14px/1.25 'Geist Variable', 'Noto Sans Khmer Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-light:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8301C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Option Chips

components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-chip { height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #D4D4D8; font: 500 13px/1 'Geist Variable', 'Noto Sans Khmer Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8301C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip.is-on { background: #E8301C; color: #FAFAFA; } .ds-chip.is-dry { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: #34D399; }

narrative.overview:
PhnomFlood reads like a field instrument pointed at the city's water. A near-black substrate, solid slabs edged with 1px hairlines, square corners everywhere, and every number set in a monospace face so values line up and never jitter as they update. The landing page and the rider app share one recipe: the landing page states it loudly with huge expanded display type and halftone imagery, the app states it quietly through the same type, rules and colour discipline at working size.

Colour is rationed. One brand accent, Hazard Red, which is also the "impassable" signal, so brand and danger never disagree. One quiet secondary, Dusk, a storm-sky violet that answers the pointer and tints a few surfaces. Everything else that carries colour is data: emerald for clear roads, amber for caution, red for blocked, sky for water. Chrome is zinc greys on near-black. A faint film grain and scan-line texture give the dark surfaces material without decoration.

Motion is a strong ease-out under 300 ms: things arrive instantly and settle. Controls are firm and fast, pressing down to 97% scale with no glow. The only pulsing, glowing elements in the system are hazards and the rider riding through water, so movement itself means "pay attention".
keyCharacteristics: Dark, never pure black (#0A0A0B); one zinc family for every neutral.
Square corners on everything; only dots, pucks and the start pin are round.
Archivo heavy and expanded for display, Geist for text, Geist Mono for every number, unit and label.
One accent (Hazard Red) and one quiet secondary (Dusk); all other colour is semantic road-status data.
1px hairlines and gap-grids instead of shadows.
Firm, fast press states; motion under 300 ms with a strong ease-out.
Khmer and English are equal: the type system adapts for Khmer script rather than forcing Latin conventions on it.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Hazard Red is the only action colour. If something is red, it is either the primary action or a blocked road; never decoration.

rules.name: The Dusk Is Touch Rule
rules.body: Dusk never marks an action and never marks road status. It appears where the pointer is, or as a quiet tinted surface, and on at most one surface per screen at rest.

rules.name: The Data Colours Are Data Rule
rules.body: Emerald, amber, red and sky mean road and water status and nothing else. Never use them for branding, illustration or emphasis.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: The darkest colour is Void (#0A0A0B). Neutrals all come from one zinc family.

rules.name: The Mono Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number, id, unit and label is set in Geist Mono with tabular figures, so values never shift sideways as they update.

rules.name: The Khmer Has No Case Rule
rules.body: In Khmer (`html[lang='km']`) labels drop uppercase and wide tracking (0.02em) and take taller line heights (1.35 for labels, 1.3 for titles) for stacked vowels. Never force Latin display conventions onto Khmer.

rules.name: The 16px Field Rule
rules.body: Every input, textarea and select is at least 16px so mobile Safari never zooms in on focus.

rules.name: The Hairline Grid Rule
rules.body: Grouped cells are built as a 1px-gap grid on a hairline-tinted parent, so the dividers are exact and never double up.

rules.name: The Glow Means Water Rule
rules.body: Nothing glows except danger. Panels, buttons and cards have no shadow and no glow at rest or on hover.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: If it is a surface or a control, its corners are square. Round is reserved for points on the map.

dos: **Do** keep every surface and control square (radius 0); use full round only for map dots and pucks.
**Do** set every number, unit, id and caption in Geist Mono with tabular figures; captions at 11px, 0.1em tracking, uppercase, Ash (#A1A1AA).
**Do** separate content with 1px hairlines at 12% white, built as gap-grids.
**Do** make primary actions Hazard Red (#E8301C), 48px tall, with a 2px focus outline at 2px offset.
**Do** keep motion under 300 ms with the punch ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); presses scale to 0.97–0.985.
**Do** honour reduced motion (drop travel and loops, keep state changes) and reduced transparency (solid panels).
**Do** switch labels and titles to the Khmer rules (no uppercase, 0.02em tracking, taller line heights) under `html[lang='km']`.
**Do** cite a source in a mono label under every statistic.
donts: **Don't** use rounded corners on panels, cards, buttons, chips or fields.
**Don't** use emerald, amber, red or sky for anything except road and water status.
**Don't** add a third brand colour, gradients or glow to chrome; glow is reserved for the rider in water.
**Don't** use Dusk for an action, a status, or body text; it is pointer feedback and quiet tint only.
**Don't** use pure black or a second grey family.
**Don't** add drop shadows to panels or cards; use tone and hairlines.
**Don't** set app text below 11px or form fields below 16px.
**Don't** rely on colour alone for a warning: pair it with shape (triangle or square), text and sound.
